# Virtual Classroom Watch

> A structured reference tracking virtual meeting and classroom platforms, their vendors, and feature capabilities.
> Tracks 22 platforms, 9 features, and 153 capabilities across 20 vendors.

## Platforms

- [8x8 Meet](https://VirtualClassroom.watch/container/8x8-meet/): active, from Quote-based
- [Adobe Connect](https://VirtualClassroom.watch/container/adobe-connect/): active, from $190/host/year
- [AnyMeeting](https://VirtualClassroom.watch/container/anymeeting/): active, from Quote-based
